verdict.rationale: Zapier documents an official SDK, @zapier/zapier-sdk, installed via npm. Its quickstart covers OAuth or client-credentials auth and executing actions across 9,000+ apps, and the docs describe a typed Node module and SDK CLI that agents can discover on npm. Missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond Node/JavaScript, in-depth SDK reference documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install @zapier/zapier-sdk via npm, authenticate with OAuth or client credentials, and execute actions across 9,000+ apps.
Agents discover them on npm and skill registries, then run them as an agent skill, a CLI, a typed Node module, or a local MCP server.
The Zapier SDK CLI lets you explore and run actions across {appCount} apps directly from your terminal, authenticated, with no OAuth setup required.
